abstract: McKinsey's 2025 survey reveals widespread AI adoption among businesses, with 78% of respondents integrating AI as a core component of their business strategy and 65% reporting measurable revenue or cost impacts from their AI implementations. The findings demonstrate that AI has moved from experimental initiatives to central business operations for the majority of surveyed organizations.
keyFindings: 78% of survey respondents report that AI is now a core part of their business strategy.
65% of respondents report measurable revenue or cost impact from AI deployments.
